import json,collections
p='answers.jsonl'; rows=[json.loads(l) for l in open(p)]; cards=[json.loads(l) for l in open('items.jsonl')]
rows[1].update(marks='y',errors=[],detail='')
rows[24]['errors']=['extra_mark','crop_overrun']
rows[45]['segmentation_detail']='Final comma is clipped at the right edge.'
rows[33]['detail']=''
with open(p,'w') as f:
 for r in rows:f.write(json.dumps(r,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(rows)==len(cards)==56
assert [r['card_id'] for r in rows]==[c['card_id'] for c in cards]
assert len({r['card_id'] for r in rows})==len(rows)
for r in rows:
 assert r['letters'] in ['y','n','u']
 assert r['marks'] in ['y','n','na']
 assert r['crop_ok'] in ['y','n']
 assert len(r['owner_crop'])==5 and all(v in ['yes','no','uncertain'] for v in r['owner_crop'].values())
 assert all(set(w)=={'label','printed'} for w in r['where'])
print('Validated count and order:',len(rows))
for k in ['letters','marks','crop_ok']:print(k,dict(collections.Counter(r[k] for r in rows)))
print('Top errors:',collections.Counter(e for r in rows for e in r['errors']).most_common(3))
